purpose: Define trust as derived evidence from explicit MeritCore human-interaction signals, recommendations, Project outcomes and review history rather than opaque global score authority.

topics.name: MeritCore Trust Evidence
topics.purpose: Define trust as derived evidence from explicit MeritCore human-interaction signals, recommendations, Project outcomes and review history rather than opaque global score authority.

semantics.source_rule: Trust consumes explicit qualifying MeritCore evidence.
semantics.derived_rule: Trust output is derived evidence, not a universal hidden social score.
semantics.authority_rule: Trust evidence does not grant AccessCore rights.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: ranking position used as trust truth

references.purpose: Recommendations may contribute to trust evidence.
